question: Will BTC Reach $68,200 by 4PM EDT on July 21st, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance reached or exceeded $68,200.00 at any point on or before 20:00 UTC (4:00 PM EDT) on July 21, 2026, as reported by Binance spot market data.
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance did not reach $68,200.00 at any point on or before 20:00 UTC (4:00 PM EDT) on July 21, 2026, as reported by Binance spot market data.

Clarifications:
- "Reached" means any single trade or last-traded price recorded on the Binance BTC/USDT spot market was at or above $68,200.00 at or before the 20:00 UTC deadline.
- Price is measured in USD-equivalent terms using the USDT spot pair (BTCUSDT) on Binance.
